messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] Model Data Download Issues
messages.body_plain:
Hi Adam,

I just ran the example code from DODSGrab and it worked fine for me.  Can
you try running it at home?  If you only get the issue while at work, then
it's likely your firewall is rejecting connections through port 9090.

If the problem follows you home, please send me the output of sessionInfo()
so I can see what version of R you're using.

Happy Thanksgiving!

Danny

Hi Deepak,

Argument of install.packages needs to be in quotes:

install.packages("rNOMADS")
library(rNOMADS)

messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

I was recently alerted to an issue with reading some grib files using
rNOMADS.  It seems to be associated with archive grib2 files when
using rNOMADS with a Windows computer.  I'm looking into it, but if
anyone has any issues please let me know.

Best,

Danny
